verses.gurmukhi: ਪੁਛਨਿ ਗਲ ਈਮਾਨ ਦੀ ਕਾਜੀ ਮੁਲਾਂ ਇਕਠੇ ਹੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: puchhan gal ieemaan dhee kaajee mulaa(n) ikaThe hoiee|

en.bdb: Qazi and maulvis got together and began discussing religion.

verses.gurmukhi: ਵਡਾ ਸਾਂਗ ਵਰਤਾਇਆ ਲਖਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: vaddaa saa(n)g varataiaa lakh na sakai kudharat koiee|

en.bdb: A great fantasy has been created and no one could understood its mystery.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੁਛਨਿ ਫੋਲਿ ਕਿਤਾਬ ਨੋ ਹਿੰਦੂ ਵਡਾ ਕਿ ਮੁਸਲਮਾਨੋਈ?
verses.translit_en: puchhan fol kitaab no hi(n)dhoo vaddaa k musalamaanoiee?

en.bdb: They asked Baba Nanak to open and search in his book whether Hindu is great or the Muslim.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਾਬਾ ਆਖੇ ਹਾਜੀਆ ਸੁਭਿ ਅਮਲਾ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਦੋਨੋ ਰੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: baabaa aakhe haajeeaa subh amalaa baajhahu dhono roiee|

en.bdb: Baba replied to the pilgrim hajis, that, without good deeds both will have to weep and  wail.

verses.gurmukhi: ਹਿੰਦੂ ਮੁਸਲਮਾਨ ਦੁਇ ਦਰਗਹ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਲਹਨਿ ਨ ਢੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: hi(n)dhoo musalamaan dhui dharageh a(n)dhar lahan na ddoiee|

en.bdb: Only by being a Hindu or a Muslim one  can not get accepted in the court of the Lord.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਚਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਕੁਸੁੰਭ ਦਾ ਪਾਣੀ ਧੋਤੈ ਥਿਰੁ ਨ ਰਹੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: kachaa ra(n)g kusu(n)bh dhaa paanee dhotai thir na rahoiee|

en.bdb: As the colour of safflower is impermanent and is washed away in water, likewise the colours of religiosity are also temporary.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਰਨਿ ਬਖੀਲੀ ਆਪਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਹੀਮ ਕੁਥਾਇ ਖਲੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: karan bakheelee aap vich raam raheem kuthai khaloiee|

en.bdb: (Followers of both the religions) In their  expositions, denounce Ram and Rahim.
The whole world is following the ways of Satan.
